definitions.explanation: Formal equivalent of で indicating a place where something occurs.
Formal equivalent of で indicating means or method.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議室|かいぎしつ}→会議室：01265_kaigishitsu⟧にて⟦{開催|かいさい}します→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧。
examples.english: It will be held in the conference room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本日|ほんじつ}→本日：09643_honjitsu⟧、⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧にて⟦{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}→記者会見：19954_kishakaiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A press conference was held in Tokyo today.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦{駅|えき}{前|まえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧にて⟦{集合|しゅうごう}して→集合する：21679_shuugousuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please gather in front of Osaka Station.

examples.japanese: ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧にて⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I will contact you by email.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書面|しょめん}→書面：13023_shomen⟧にて⟦{回答|かいとう}→回答：00142_kaitou⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧にてお⟦{支払|しはら}い→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧⟦いただけます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

notes:
A formal particle that is the classical/literary equivalent of ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧. It was the standard form in classical Japanese and survives in modern formal contexts. It can indicate location (where something happens) and means/method (how something is done).

USAGE:
- Replaces ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ in formal written contexts: announcements, business correspondence, official notices
- Very common in event announcements: ～にて⟦{開催|かいさい}→開催：10457_kaisai⟧ (held at ~)
- Common in business communication: ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧にて, ⟦{書面|しょめん}→書面：13023_shomen⟧にて, ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧にて
- Sounds overly formal or archaic in casual conversation
- Sometimes seen at the end of letters or messages: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧にて (written in Tokyo)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～にて⟦{開催|かいさい}→開催：10457_kaisai⟧: held at ~
- ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧にて: by email
- ⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧にて: on-site, at the location
- ⟦{本日|ほんじつ}→本日：09643_honjitsu⟧にて⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧: ending as of today

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: at, in, by — the standard casual/neutral equivalent
- ⟦において→において：06799_nioite⟧: in, at — also formal but specifically for "in the context of"; more common in academic writing
- ⟦をもって→をもって：06946_womotte⟧: with, by means of — very formal; used in official documents for deadlines and methods
